why_chosen: Current non-preview small Google Flash-class chat model that lists temperature support; billed reasoning tokens were zero in probe calls with and without a reasoning-off request, so no reasoning switch is sent. It replaces claude-haiku-4.5 (USD 1/5 per million), whose roughly USD 6 estimate for the worked sweep would have exceeded the USD 8 total; the newer claude-haiku-5.5 does not list temperature support and cannot run at temperature 0.
limitations: Same small arithmetic-routing replication as the one-shot run. Worked variant: brief step-by-step working before the final JSON line. Sequential calls within a trial, trials in parallel threads; wall latency sums observed attempts including invalids and one-second retry backoffs, so it excludes queueing between trials. Provider routing on OpenRouter may differ between calls.
fallback: worked: last JSON object parsed and strictly validated; a response cut off by max_tokens (finish_reason length) is invalid. one-shot other models: a markdown code fence around the bare JSON object is stripped before the same strict validation. One retry; then exclude invalid bidder; unserved if all invalid; centralized invalid after retry leaves task unserved
